endpoint.params: from/to in local calendar days, optional productSlug/timezoneRevision/sources.
endpoint.returns: StatsDTO: authorized source list, metrics, coverage, actual data time, and separate status for each source.
endpoint.permission: ADMIN all sources; SALES business scope; EDITOR public traffic and 3D.

role_definitions.anonymous: No backend account session or backend role. An endpoint may still require a particular enrollment/recovery/consent credential. Such a caller remains anonymous to the backend authorization system and gets only the explicitly restricted operation.
role_definitions.visitor_session: A valid necessary chat visitor cookie. It authorizes only conversations owned by that cookie, never any backend account privilege.
role_definitions.authenticated_self: A valid current backend account/device acting on its own account. All ADMIN, SALES, and EDITOR accounts may use self-account functions; no ADMIN-only or SALES-only business authorization is implied.
role_definitions.EDITOR: A current valid backend EDITOR; public traffic/product/3D aggregates only, no shared chat or system sources.
role_definitions.SALES: A current valid backend SALES; shared human chat inbox, traffic/3D and inquiry counts under the existing sales scope. No system sources.
role_definitions.ADMIN: A current valid backend ADMIN, full authorized administration subject to fresh-grant and target restrictions.
role_definitions.cron: A controlled server job or reporting script authenticated by the dedicated Bearer CRON_SECRET. A browser session, including ADMIN, cannot substitute for that secret.
role_definitions.public: No authentication or endpoint-specific credential is required; same-origin checks and rate limiting may still apply.

contract_context: Read-only dashboard. ADMIN may request traffic/3D/inquiries/chat/API errors/mail/storage/backup. SALES may request traffic/3D, inquiry counts under existing sales scope, and shared chat counts. EDITOR may request only public traffic and product/3D aggregates. Apply role/source filters server-side before querying; lower-privilege DTOs omit hidden sources and counts, and direct requests for system sources return 403. Inquiry counts come from Inquiry under scope, chat from ChatConversation/ChatMessage/ChatNotification, mail from MailMessage and actual outbox state, traffic from AnalyticsDaily and real aggregation state. API coverage is only the newly wired API final-response counters, never a claimed whole-site error rate. Storage/backup are controlled reports containing only metrics and real completion/verification times, not paths or contents. Per-source states are ok/zero/no_data/not_connected/query_failed/stale with value number/null, timezone/revision, dataThrough, queriedAt, lastSucceededAt, coverage. A failed source is not zero and does not block other sources. GET never writes state, collects data, sends mail, or runs backup.
